courses.title: Individualūs jogos užsiėmimai (individual yoga classes)
courses.description: One-to-one Sivananda yoga lessons at the centre in Kaunas. The teacher builds the session around the student's level, physical condition and goals, from a safe introduction to yoga to deeper work on asanas, breathing and relaxation.

left_out: Jogos kursai sveikai nugarai (yoga for a healthy back): the home page still links https://pranajoga.lt/ivykiai/joga-sveikai-nugarai, but that page returns 404 and the seminars page no longer lists it, so it isn't current. Not a health reason.
flags: Individual classes: the page says lessons are adapted to the student's 'sveikatos būklę' (health condition) and suit people with 'specifinių fizinių ar sveikatos iššūkių' (specific physical or health challenges); it makes no claim to treat anything. Kept under the new rule. Price 'Individuali pamoka: 40 €' from https://www.pranajoga.lt/jogos-uzsiemimu-ir-gyvu-grupiniu-meditaciju-tvarkarastis (the page the individual-classes page links for prices).
